description.en: build voice-first AI apps with Realtime API, ElevenLabs, and speech-to-text pipelines
description.zh: 用 Realtime API、ElevenLabs 和语音转文字流水线构建语音优先的 AI 应用

goal.en: Build voice AI apps end to end
goal.zh: 端到端构建语音 AI 应用

outcome.en: Go from zero to a production voice AI app: wire up speech-to-text, route through Claude for reasoning, and synthesize responses with natural-sounding voice output. Build phone agents, voice assistants, real-time translators, and accessibility tools — all without a PhD in audio engineering.
outcome.zh: 从零到生产级语音 AI 应用：接入语音转文字、通过 Claude 进行推理、用自然语音合成响应。构建电话 Agent、语音助手、实时翻译和无障碍工具——无需音频工程背景。

reason.en: The reasoning brain of your voice app — process transcribed speech, maintain conversation context, decide when to speak vs. wait, and generate natural responses.
reason.zh: 语音应用的推理大脑——处理转录语音、维护对话上下文、决定何时响应、生成自然回复。

en: Build a voice assistant that books calendar events
Create a phone agent that answers customer questions
Add voice input/output to my existing Claude app
zh: 构建一个可以预订日历事件的语音助手
创建一个回答客户问题的电话 Agent
为我现有的 Claude 应用添加语音输入/输出

reason.en: Scaffold the voice pipeline — WebSocket handlers for streaming audio, VAD (voice activity detection), chunked transcription, and TTS integration.
reason.zh: 搭建语音流水线——用于流式音频的 WebSocket 处理器、VAD（语音活动检测）、分块转录和 TTS 集成。

en: Build a WebSocket server for real-time audio streaming
Add voice activity detection to my app
Integrate ElevenLabs TTS into my voice pipeline
zh: 构建用于实时音频流的 WebSocket 服务器
给我的应用添加语音活动检测
将 ElevenLabs TTS 集成到我的语音流水线

reason.en: Expose voice capabilities as MCP tools — let any agent trigger TTS, transcription, or phone calls via a standardized interface.
reason.zh: 将语音能力暴露为 MCP 工具——让任何 Agent 通过标准接口触发 TTS、转录或电话呼叫。

en: Build an MCP tool that triggers a phone call
Expose my TTS endpoint as an MCP tool for other agents
Create a transcription MCP server for my audio files
zh: 构建一个触发电话呼叫的 MCP 工具
将我的 TTS 端点作为 MCP 工具暴露给其他 Agent
为我的音频文件创建转录 MCP Server
